segments.name: Marketplace
segments.description: Runs an online marketplace where freelancers sell digital services to buyers, alongside dropshipping automation and talent platforms.
segments.evidence: "Gig" or "Gigs" means the services offered on the Fiverr marketplace.

revenueModel.text: Buyers pay for digital services ordered as Gigs on the marketplace, and the company earns marketplace revenue plus fees for additional services.
revenueModel.evidence: "Buyers" means users who purchase digital services.
